held_out_dispositions.resolution: Retain in discovery; exclude from strict slide layer because the public source confirms surviving Harting preparations but does not close them specifically as glass microscope slides.
Correct closure-stage shorthand from Flemming/Lund to Flemming/Kiel. Kiel institutional history states that anatomical writings and preparations were lost when the institute was destroyed in 1944.

held_out_dispositions.lead: King's College London Museum of Life Sciences
held_out_dispositions.resolution: Museum-wide holdings include microscope slides and specimens dating from the early nineteenth century onward, but public pages do not identify a closed nineteenth-century slide subset. The Dawes two-cabinet slide collection is explicitly mid-twentieth-century and therefore out of period.
Earlier audit remains in force: nineteenth-century collection dating and histological-preparation evidence are not yet closed onto the same surviving slide objects.

validation.claim: The closure is a data-audit freeze, not a claim that a fresh final GitHub Actions run passed. Check-run status is queried after the final manifest commit.

reopening_policy: Any later discovery, corrected attribution, new institutional reply, newly digitised register, or revised item count must enter a later version/reopening rather than silently extending this CLOSED_2026-08-09 state.
